scale: 0.00 to 1.00; higher means the player is expected to physically visit/use the module more often
method: Gameplay-informed default weights for the user-defined weighted room-pair objective. These are planner assumptions, not hidden game constants. Weight 0 excludes a module from objective pairs while the module remains subject to all hard placement/connectivity constraints.

airlock.rationale: Primary entry/exit; every ordinary surface trip starts or ends here.

workshop.rationale: Very frequent crafting and quest-item interaction.

command_center.rationale: Frequent base rearrangement, expansion and journey interaction.

kitchen.rationale: Recurring food/canteen use, but not every task requires Jan to enter it.

research_lab.rationale: Strategically frequent, but much research work is delegated.

communication_room.rationale: Recurring Earth/Ally Corp communications, but episodic.

infirmary.rationale: Important during treatment and emergencies, otherwise intermittent.

refinery.rationale: Production room usually operated by an Alter.

greenhouse.rationale: Production room usually operated by an Alter.

quantum_computer.rationale: Critical but rarely physically visited compared with operational rooms.

womb.rationale: Essential story module but rarely physically visited outside Alter creation/events.

dormitory.rationale: Used by Alters; low direct Jan traffic.

radiation_repulsor.rationale: Passive utility; no routine visit objective.

small_storage.rationale: Passive storage; no need to enter it for routine inventory use.

medium_storage.rationale: Passive storage; no need to enter it for routine inventory use.

large_storage.rationale: Passive storage; no need to enter it for routine inventory use.

ark_sarcophagus.rationale: Storage/terminal module excluded from travel pairs.

rapidium_ark.rationale: Storage/terminal module excluded from travel pairs.
